test_title: PYST 09: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 09 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: VO Chidambaram Pillai was actively involved in the revolutionary movement in which of the following areas?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Madras**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **V.O. Chidambaram Pillai**, also known as "Kappalottiya Tamilan," was a prominent **Indian freedom fighter** and a key figure in the **Swadeshi Movement**.
 
• He was actively involved in the revolutionary movement in the region of **Madras Presidency**, which is now a part of modern-day **Tamil Nadu.**
 
• He was instrumental in establishing the **first indigenous shipping service**, the Swadeshi Steam Navigation Company, to compete with British shipping companies.
 
• V.O. Chidambaram Pillai was deeply influenced by the ideas of **Bal Gangadhar Tilak** and used his entrepreneurial skills to strengthen the **Swadeshi Movement**.
 
• He contributed significantly to the cause of **economic independence** by promoting indigenous industries and creating awareness about the exploitation by colonial powers.
 
• He was arrested by the British authorities in 1908 for his revolutionary activities and was subjected to rigorous imprisonment, including forced labor.
 
• His life and legacy remain an integral part of the history of the freedom struggle in the **Madras region**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Delhi**__

 __
 
• Delhi was a significant center during India's freedom struggle, but it was more prominently associated with movements like the **1857 Revolt** and the activities of revolutionaries such as **Bhagat Singh** and others during the later phases of the struggle.
 
• However, V.O. Chidambaram Pillai's revolutionary activities were not focused in Delhi.
 
 
 
• **Bombay**__
 __
 
• Bombay (now Mumbai) was the hub of many prominent leaders like **Gopal Krishna Gokhale** and **Dadabhai Naoroji**, and was central to the early phases of the Indian National Congress.
 
• Though Bombay played a major role in the freedom movement, V.O. Chidambaram Pillai’s contributions were focused in the **Madras region.**
 
 
 
• **Calcutta**__
 
 
• Calcutta (now Kolkata) was the capital of British India until 1911 and a major center for revolutionary activities led by groups like the **Anushilan Samiti** and leaders such as **Aurobindo Ghosh**.
 
• While Calcutta was pivotal in shaping the freedom movement, V.O. Chidambaram Pillai's work was concentrated in **Madras Presidency**.
